configurationMigrationHint: Review renamed settings in this scope. Applying moves compatible old values to empty new fields. Existing or incompatible values are preserved. Save or reload pending edits first.

configurationMigrationStatus.incompatible: Value or scope incompatible; kept unchanged

configurationHint: Configure plugin parameters here. Credentials are not supported in ordinary settings. Configuration does not grant extra permissions.
configurationIssues: Some saved fields are incompatible and have been ignored. Stored data is retained:
configurationInvalid: A value does not match the declared type or bounds.
configurationConflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept. Reload the configuration before trying again.
documentConflict: The file changed on disk. Your draft is kept; saving was blocked. Copy the draft before closing and reopening the file to resolve the conflict.
defaultViewer: Use by default for this file type
viewerDirty: Save or discard changes before switching viewers.
viewerFallback: Plugin viewer unavailable. Using the built-in viewer.
hostBoundary: This list manages third-party local plugins. Built-in tools and shared sessions remain host-managed; local plugins have no external service connection.
title: Local plugins
subtitle: Manage local plugin sources, permissions and entries
developmentHint: Run local plugins after reviewing their permissions. Turning this off disables all local plugins.
grantHint: Enable grants all listed permissions within the selected projects. Application views cannot read project files.
uninstallHint: Uninstall removes plugin resources and entries. Private data is retained; linked source files are retained.
deleteHint: Permanently delete this plugin's private data? Active plugin pages will be closed.
